agentCommerce.description: The full machine-readable catalog of every course, eBook, and product by Lawrence Lanoff / The Naked Press — signed AOP offers, each purchasable by an autonomous agent via x402 (HTTP 402). shop.description: Direct-purchase catalog of courses and eBooks by Lawrence Lanoff / The Naked Press. Machine-readable list (id, title, priceCents, buyable) at productCatalog; buy any item via checkoutUrlPattern with its id. One-time purchase, instant streaming/download delivery.

agentNotes: Tantra Authority is an early node in the agent-to-agent payment graph. Endpoints follow HTTP 402 (x402) for machine-readable payment negotiation. Default rail is non-custodial Lightning. Re-access within the TTL window uses the Bearer token returned on first payment. For batch / enterprise rates contact the publisher.
